limitations: AI/control fixtures isolate map support; not combat survival or human input feel.
Separate independent probes rebuild the map after recording a terminal fall; this is not runtime recovery.
Exit-gallery center traversal and wall strafes supplement the independent Foundation full-width stair audit.
Headless runs verify actual Godot physics, not native visual acceptance.
recommended_geometry_fixes: Provide fixed shaft containment/floor below both landings to stop any actor falling out when the platform is absent.
Use platform-synchronized physical landing gates, closed during travel and while the platform is away, to prevent lower-entry and upper-disembark access to an empty shaft.
Keep the deck-to-landing floor overlap and add clear lift/call signage rather than implying an always-present staircase.
scope: Actual native Main CharacterBody W/A/S/D movement, moving-platform carry, fixed-landing E calls and collision-floor/edge audit. Initial placements and cleared-final/exit-control flags are declared independent probe setup; enemy AI frozen. No recovery, collision disabling, invulnerability, ammo/health tuning, scene/pickup movement or old user-process manipulation.
